name: Clinic network EHR
tagline: Terse clinical codes in a legacy Databricks EHR mapped to a Snowflake warehouse.
scenario: A network of outpatient clinics is consolidating its legacy electronic health record extracts (Databricks) into a Snowflake clinical warehouse. All patients, clinicians and clinics are fictional; the metadata contains no patient data.
source: Databricks: legacy_ehr.clinical, scheduling, reference (7 tables, short clinical codes)

examples.what: BIRTH_DT, with a text-to-date conversion from the Excel S2T sheet.
RSLT_VAL, with a warning that values like <5 need cleansing.
DX_CD, with the ICD-9/ICD-10 caveat in the dictionary.
Derived from APPT_STAT_CD per the S2T sheet.
